metadata.question: Was there an active fire present in Monte Pisano in Northern Italy between February 24, 2019 and February 26, 2019?

1. Search strategy: Use VIIRS VNP14A1 (NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1) daily fire mask over Monte Pisano (point near 43.77N, 10.49E buffered 15 km) from 2019-02-24 to 2019-02-27 (inclusive of 26). Fallback to MODIS MOD14A1 (MODIS/061/MOD14A1) if needed.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking (fire mask product already classifies fire). Use FireMask >= 2 as active fire. Count valid pixels via mask.
3. Logic: 
   - C1 if both collections return 0 images.
   - C2 if images exist but valid pixel count is 0 after masking.
   - C3 if totals are null/NaN/invalid.
   - A if any fire pixels detected; B otherwise.

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

function eeEvaluate(obj) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.evaluate((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const center = ee.Geometry.Point([10.49, 43.77]);
    const region = center.buffer(15000); // ~15 km around Monte Pisano
    const start = '2019-02-24';
    const end = '2019-02-27'; // end-exclusive, covers through 2019-02-26

    console.log('Region center: 10.49,43.77 (buffer 15 km)');
    console.log('Date range: 2019-02-24 to 2019-02-26');

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    let datasetId = 'NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1';
    let col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(region).select('FireMask');
    let size = await eeEvaluate(col.size());

    if (!size || size === 0) {
      // Fallback to MODIS
      datasetId = 'MODIS/061/MOD14A1';
      col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(region).select('FireMask');
      size = await eeEvaluate(col.size());
      console.log(`Primary dataset had 0 images. Fallback to ${datasetId}.`);
    } else {
      console.log(`Primary dataset: ${datasetId}. Images: ${size}`);
    }

    if (!size || size === 0) {
      console.log('No images found in date/location.');
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing: per-image counts (valid vs fire pixels)
    const scale = 1000; // per best practice
    const perImageFC = ee.FeatureCollection(col.map(function(i) {
      const fm = i.select('FireMask');
      const validCountRaw = ee.Image(1).updateMask(fm.mask()).rename('m').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('m');
      const validCount = ee.Number(ee.Algorithms.If(validCountRaw, validCountRaw, 0));

      const fireMask = fm.gte(2); // fire pixels: low/nominal/high confidence
      const fireCountRaw = fireMask.updateMask(fireMask).rename('m').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('m');
      const fireCount = ee.Number(ee.Algorithms.If(fireCountRaw, fireCountRaw, 0));

      const date = ee.Date(i.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd');
      return ee.Feature(null, {date: date, valid: validCount, fire: fireCount});
    }));

    // 4. Calculation and validation
    const dates = await eeEvaluate(perImageFC.aggregate_array('date'));
    const valids = await eeEvaluate(perImageFC.aggregate_array('valid'));
    const fires = await eeEvaluate(perImageFC.aggregate_array('fire'));
    const totalValid = await eeEvaluate(perImageFC.aggregate_sum('valid'));
    const totalFire = await eeEvaluate(perImageFC.aggregate_sum('fire'));

    if (totalValid === null || totalFire === null || !isFinite(totalValid) || !isFinite(totalFire) || totalValid < 0 || totalFire < 0) {
      console.log('Computation invalid (null/NaN).');
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      return;
    }

    if (totalValid === 0) {
      console.log(`Images: ${size}, but 0 valid pixels within region after masking.`);
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Print concise evidence lines
    console.log(`Dataset used: ${datasetId}, Images: ${size}`);
    for (let i = 0; i < dates.length; i++) {
      const vp = valids[i] || 0;
      const fp = fires[i] || 0;
      const perc = vp > 0 ? (100 * fp / vp) : 0;
      console.log(`${dates[i]} firePix: ${fp} validPix: ${vp} fire%: ${perc.toFixed(3)}`);
    }
    console.log(`Total firePix: ${totalFire} ; Total validPix: ${totalValid}`);

    // 6. Final Answer
    if (totalFire > 0) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Syntax/dataset/band/processing errors
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
